summary: Vector schema inconsistency causing degraded rerank precision and endpoint latency spikes
description:
Issue summary: Customer reports sudden drop in rerank quality coincident with increased 5xx/504 responses from the /rerank endpoint. Impact: Search/rerank queries for several CipherHealth production routes are timing out or returning degraded ranking order. Observed after a model catalog update on 2026-03-09.

Immediate impact: Production user flows for clinical content ranking are failing, causing degraded UX and increased support tickets.

Wanted: Root cause analysis and a reliable mitigation path so customer can continue production traffic.
steps_to_reproduce:
1) Use CipherHealth production account to call /embed with model=rwd-embed-large-v2, receive embeddings (client observed length=1536).
2) Send embeddings to /rerank with model=rwd-rerank-v1 and top_k=10.
3) Observe 500/504 errors or a rerank response that places obviously irrelevant results at top (precision drop).
4) Repeat with pinned model rwd-embed-legacy-1 and rerank succeeds with expected quality.

ValueError: shapes (batch,2048) and (1536,) not aligned
investigation_notes:
Initial hypothesis: client-side embedding/model mismatch. We confirmed client reported embeddings length 1536 while reranker expects 2048. Timeline aligns with embedding model upgrade (rwd-embed-large-v2).
Deeper finding: the catalog entry for rwd-embed-large-v2 had changed canonical dimension metadata to 1536 but the rerank pipeline configuration (rwd-rerank-v1) cached an older compatibility table expecting 2048. Batching path did not validate dims until the dot-product op, causing upstream timeouts and failed batches.
We also observed a secondary effect: when the batch worker encountered a shape mismatch it retried at the serving-runtime layer, causing long queue hold times and cascading 504s for other requests in the batch pool.
customer_impact: CipherHealth production search/rerank routes experiencing intermittent 5xxs and incorrect ranking ordering from 2026-03-09 14:00 UTC; estimated 12% of requests affected during peak windows, leading to degraded user workflows for clinicians.
workaround:
1) Temporary mitigation applied 2026-03-11 19:20 UTC: reverted catalog alias for rwd-embed-large-v2 to previous manifest (pinned to legacy dims).
2) Customer advised to pin embedding model on client side to rwd-embed-legacy-1 until fix rolled.
3) Added an API gateway request validation rule to reject rerank calls where embedding length doesn't match model manifest (400 with clear error).
resolution: Deployed compatibility shim in reranker-service on 2026-03-12 04:15 UTC that: validates embedding vector length at ingestion, pads/truncates vectors in a deterministic way when compatible policy allows, and emits metrics when auto-adjustment occurs. Also updated model catalog and reranker config sync logic to invalidate caches on catalog rev increments. Verified CipherHealth traffic stable and rerank quality restored. Patch PR: github.com/redwood-inference/reranker-service/pull/427. Follow-up: add an alert for embedding-dim mismatch rate >0.1%.

2) Add an observable metric and PagerDuty alert for embedding-dim mismatch rate.
